Validate MR1 Data Package

Source: R/validateDataPackage.R
validateDataPackage.Rd

validateDataPackage() checks whether an MR1 data package, created by createDataPackage(), is complete and consistent before it is published, e.g. on Zenodo. It checks:

  • the package structure (Frictionless Data Package) and the package-level metadata (the same checks as in createDataPackage(), plus the properties that createDataPackage() adds automatically);

  • that all five resources (echo_data, protocol_data, blind_times, sunrise_sunset, site_data) are present, can be read, and contain the required columns;

  • that the column names and types match the Table Schema of each resource, and that every column has a description;

  • that primary keys are unique and not missing, and that foreign keys (e.g. protocolID of the echoes) refer to existing rows;

  • that the content is plausible: start times before stop times, echoes within their measurement period and within the temporal coverage, and site coordinates equal to the spatial coverage.

Problems that make the package unusable or inconsistent are reported as errors; problems that do not, e.g. a column without description, as warnings. A package is valid when there are no errors.

Usage

validateDataPackage(package)

Arguments

package

MR1 data package object returned by createDataPackage() or frictionless::read_package(), or the path to a datapackage.json file or to the directory that contains it.

Value

An object of class mr1dpValidation: a list with valid (logical, TRUE if no errors were found) and issues (data frame with the columns level ("error" or "warning"), resource, field and message). Printing it gives a summary of the issues.

See also

Other write file functions: addZenodoRelatedIdentifiers(), compileData(), createDataPackage(), createDataPackageMetadataTemplate(), saveMTR(), savePlotToFile(), uploadDataPackageToZenodo()

Author

Birgen Haest

Examples

# \donttest{
# Load example data
# ===========================================================================
dbData = readRDS(system.file("extdata",
  "CH_Sempach_2024_SEP24_25_DataExtract.rds",
  package = "birdscanR"
))
mainOutputDir = tempdir()

# Write the package metadata template (fill it in for a real campaign)
# ===========================================================================
metadataFile = file.path(mainOutputDir, "CH_Sempach_2024_metadata.yaml")
createDataPackageMetadataTemplate(filePath = metadataFile, overwrite = TRUE)

# Create MR1 data package
# ===========================================================================
dataPackage = createDataPackage(
  dbExtract          = dbData,
  metadata           = metadataFile,
  pulseTypeSelection = "S",
  outputDirPath      = mainOutputDir
)

# Validate the data package object
# ===========================================================================
validateDataPackage(dataPackage)

# Validate the data package files on disk
# ===========================================================================
validation = validateDataPackage(file.path(mainOutputDir, "CH_Sempach_2024"))
validation$valid
